name: Maffei 1 (Hubble)
blurb: Maffei 1, a large galaxy hidden behind dust in the Milky Way, seen by Hubble.
label: maffei1-hubble
story: Veiled by the dust of our own galaxy, Maffei 1 lay unknown until 1968, when Paolo Maffei found it. Hubble searched its crowded starlight for red giants to measure the distance to the group it rules.

claims.text: MAFFEI-1 is a target of Hubble program 12877, 'Exposing the Maffei Group', which uses the tip of the red giant branch to measure distances to the obscured Maffei-IC 342 complex
Maffei 1 is hidden in visible light by dust in IC 1805 and was unknown until 1968 when Paolo Maffei found it
Maffei 1 is described as a lenticular galaxy
Maffei 1 is the dominant galaxy of the Maffei group, typed E
The Maffei/IC 342 galaxies lie at low Galactic latitudes with severe extinction
